tess: quick note onboarding sable-12b (gguf -> state-dict) shows notable summarization degradation after int8 + rotary->relative-adapter. local rouge dropped from 0.57(fp16) -> 0.43(int8).
omar: ouch. any short sample outputs? could be tokenizer index drift or freq aliasing.
tess: prompt: "Steps to safely publish scraped forum data."
tess: fp16: "Inventory PII, perform redaction, check licenses, attach provenance, and limit retention. Legal review advised."
tess: int8+adapter: "Watch privacy and licensing. Apply filters." <-- terser, loses checklist items.
li: that pattern usually means long-range positional energy collapsed. did you inspect rotary.freqs?
tess: dumped freqs: shape (160,) log-spaced but with micro-jitter every 8 entries (suspect float parsing bug). adapter linearly resampled to heads=64.
omar: linear resample + jitter => spectral aliasing. plus int8 calibration likely clips slopes. two fixes: preserve original spectral envelope when resampling (e.g., windowed sinc) and stash pos-slopes as fp32 so runtime doesn't quantize them.
jules: also check vocab mapping. i noticed some gguf exports insert extra control tokens around emojis, shifting indices >50000. conversion by index remap breaks those tokens. remap by token-string instead.
li: good call. for adapter patch i propose:

li: ```python
# pos_patch.py (sketch)
def compute_head_slopes(freqs, heads):
    # windowed sinc resample to preserve spectral shape
    xi = np.linspace(0, len(freqs)-1, heads*4)
    # simple sinc interp + hann window
    # ...compute resampled then collapse to per-head mean magnitude
    return slopes.astype('float32')  # keep fp32 in state-dict
```

li: runtime flag: if pos_slopes_fp32 present, load as-is and skip quantization.
tess: pushed adapter change locally. quick 40-prompt smoke: int8 MRR rose 0.48 -> 0.52 with fp32 slope stash + token-string remap + per-row embed calib for high-id tokens. still ~0.05 behind fp16 but much better.
omar: remaining gap probably Q/K/V per-head scale quantization. try per-head symmetric quant for Q/K/V and bias re-centering during calibration.
jules: i'll add conversion unit tests: 1) token-string remap guarantee, 2) float parsing sanity for freq arrays (no floored values), 3) monotonicity check for freqs to warn.
_dev-bot_: [ci-eval] sable/int8-pos-stash queued (job 1855554330) logs at /ci/jobs/1855554330/report.json
tess: thanks all. plan: 1) land adapter sinc-resample + fp32 slope stash 2) token-string remap on conversion 3) per-row embed quant for rare tokens 4) per-head QKV quant experiment 5) RFC for runtime fallback for pos slopes. filing RFC now. :thumbsup:
